portal.contour_anchored: yes — trunks skeletonised from the subject's own portal_vein_and_splenic_vein label

hepatic_venous.contour_anchored: no — the source release has no hepatic-vein label; only the caval ostium is anchored on the real IVC, the three trunk courses are constructed from measured landmark planes
hepatic_venous.common_trunk_assumption: MHV and LHV share a common caval trunk (majority anatomical variant, ~60-80 %); assumption, not measured on this subject

trunk_planes.azimuth_frame: azimuth 0 deg = Cantlie-plane normal (patient left), +90 deg along e2 = cross(caval axis, e1), measured about the caval axis from the hepatocaval confluence

hepatic_venous.trunk_calibration: r_term set from the published 8-11 mm right-hepatic-vein ostium diameter, not measured

hepatic_arterial.contour_anchored: no — synthetic, generated as a portal-triad companion of the portal tree

biliary.contour_anchored: no — synthetic, portal-triad companion; flow is retrograde

segment_subdivision.note: cosmetic curvature only — intermediate nodes, no new terminals or bifurcations, no radius change; bifurcation counts, downstream terminal counts and Murray residuals are unaffected. The clearance audit below runs on the SUBDIVIDED geometry.
